_about: Every gate a command can require. Decisions are set only by scripts/approve.py (through Paul's /approve). 'met' means Approved or Approved with Conditions, and the files recorded with THAT approval are unchanged. An edit voids only the gate whose file changed; later gates are flagged 'upstream change' and stay open. Each decision gate names its artifact (the status.json mark that lists the files the approval covers) and its producer (the command that writes them). Conditions are checked by the scripts, never approved.
